canonical.name: Defines the normalized equivariant BM model, stable 2rm shift, right Milnor coefficient ring, character classes, S_T, proper/open operations, cap action and complex fundamental class.
A nonvanishing eigenfunction gives an equivariant trivialization of its character line on D(f); its first Chern class annihilates BM by cap product, so localization kills each such open.

Finite algebraic eigen-generators give a finite invariant principal-open cover of X minus F. The proof uses finite Cech descent, localized BM exactness and the actual closed/open triangle; the Chow proof is not substituted.

The fixed scheme is smooth, the normal bundle has only nonzero character weights, the normalized Gysin self-intersection is the Euler cap action, and the weight-product leading term plus nilpotent positive-degree ideal gives a finite localized inverse on proper F.
Defines p_loc as the proper Borel–Moore trace after the canonical localized fixed-inclusion inverse; specifies the class insertion and grading.
Uses concentration, proper-trace functoriality and self-intersection to derive the fixed-component denominator formula, map compatibility, proper case, and boundary cases.
